newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH PARTIES' RANKINGS DELAYED DUE TO FLOOD.
newsitem.headline: POLISH PARTIES' RANKINGS DELAYED DUE TO FLOOD.

text.p: Public opinion polls showing popularity of political parties in Poland before the September 21 general elections will be delayed until August due to recent heavy floods, officials at polling agencies said on Wednesday.
The public CBOS and private Demoskop agencies will carry out surveys at the end of July while OBOP, linked to the public television, will conduct a poll in August, they said.

"A package of surveys about Poles' political sentiments, which will take into account an impact of the flood, will be carried out by July 31," Demoskop's Robert Traczyk told Reuters. The results will be available in the second week of August.
CBOS plans a survey for July 28-31 and wants to publish its result on August 4. OBOP will conduct its polling between August 21 and 24, with results released in early September.

Opinion polls carried out before the flood, which started nearly three weeks ago and swamped nearly 6,000 square km killing 55, showed the ruling ex-communist slightly ahead of the rightist opposition Solidarity Election Action (AWS).
But some analysts have said the flood and media criticism of the way the government had handled it may harm the ruling party's popularity.
